## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run format:check`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass locally.
- [ ] New behavior has tests. Changes to the scope matcher include a property-based test.
- [ ] The change cannot let an attenuated token permit a request its parent denies.
- [ ] `openapi.yaml`, the README and `CHANGELOG.md` reflect any API or CLI change.
- [ ] The PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).
